storyboard.claim: Darrow is sealed inside a suffocating nanoplastic suit.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow in the rigid fry suit, faceplate up, sweating.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Cold open on the helldiver.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the suit and its suffocation before the narrator finishes the sentence.
storyboard.staging: Worried face, idle body: the callout carries the suit.

storyboard.claim: The suit is unbreathable and smothering heat.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow with a heavy quilt-like suit, the heat rising around him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the suit description.
storyboard.addedInformation: Turns the smothering heat into a picture the viewer can hold.
storyboard.staging: Same figure, worried, the quilt simile carried by the callout.

storyboard.claim: Darrow plunges down a ninety-metre vertical shaft into the crust of Mars.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow falling down a shaft seen from below, motion streaks.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the suit to the descent.
storyboard.addedInformation: Gives the depth as a number on screen.
storyboard.staging: Falling pose with an afraid face: the drop is the subject.

storyboard.claim: Darrow rides the massive claw drill, a metal hand.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow gripping the giant metal claw of the drill.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the descent.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes the drill a claw the viewer can see.
storyboard.staging: Darrow braced on the claw, sweat implied by the worried face.

storyboard.claim: Sweat stings his eyes and he cannot wipe it, scanning the shadows for vipers.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Close view of Darrow's face behind the rigid faceplate, eyes narrowed into the dark.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Inside the suit, from the drop to the danger.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the rigid faceplate as the reason he cannot wipe the sweat.
storyboard.staging: Scanning the shadows: think pose, worried face.

storyboard.claim: Pit vipers are massive black reptiles that burrow into your belly for warmth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow with a fearful face, the dark pit around him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From scanning to the threat.
storyboard.addedInformation: Says what the reptiles want, which the sound alone does not show.
storyboard.staging: Afraid face; no icon fits a reptile, so the callout names the threat.

storyboard.claim: His boot jams in the gears near the molten drill fingers and its heel melts.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A fire icon over the melting boot heel in the gears.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The danger turns physical.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes the melting boot the fire, read literally.
storyboard.staging: Afraid face on Darrow, fire shows the melting heel.

storyboard.claim: In seconds the layers burn into his flesh, and he does not stop.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Close view of Darrow's boot and leg in the heat.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The melt escalates to his body.
storyboard.addedInformation: Puts the time limit on the injury.
storyboard.staging: Afraid face in close-up; the callout carries the timing.

storyboard.claim: He pulls out a curved cutter, slices himself free, burns his knuckles, and keeps climbing.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow with a cutter in hand, angry defiance, burned knuckles.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the trapped boot to the escape.
storyboard.addedInformation: Defiance: he acts instead of stopping.
storyboard.staging: Angry face for grit; the cutter has no icon, so the callout carries the act.

callout.text: Not a gun to your head

storyboard.claim: The guard laughs; nobody forces Darrow to do this.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dan smirking and pointing at Darrow in the shaft, Darrow below.
storyboard.onScreenText: Not a gun to your head
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shifts from Darrow's act to the Gold who watches.
storyboard.addedInformation: Rejects the gun idea: the pressure is not force.
storyboard.staging: Smirk on Dan, not happy, so the laughing reads as menace.

storyboard.claim: He willingly burns his own flesh out of fanatical devotion.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Fire icon with Darrow's angry, fixed face.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the choice behind the injury.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes the fanatical devotion read as self-harm.
storyboard.staging: Angry, fixed face: fanaticism, not joy.

callout.text: Pride for the system that enslaves

storyboard.claim: Fanatical pride to hit a quota: the human joyfully mutilates himself for the system that enslaves him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow with a proud, edged smile, pointing up toward the quota board.
storyboard.onScreenText: Pride for the system that enslaves
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the injury into a willing act.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the system as the object of the pride.
storyboard.staging: Smirk shows the pride with an edge, not warmth.

callout.text: The slave believes he is a hero

storyboard.claim: The most effective control is when the slave believes he is a hero, not when he is whipped.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow celebrating in belief while the Gold guard stands behind him.
storyboard.onScreenText: The slave believes he is a hero
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Generalises the scene into the principle.
storyboard.addedInformation: Adds the contrast: whipping versus belief.
storyboard.staging: Happy on Darrow is genuine belief, the guard stands by unseen as the power.

storyboard.claim: The hosts introduce the deep dive into Red Rising and its cast system.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A book icon for the novel Red Rising.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the scene to the book it comes from.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the author and the book.
storyboard.staging: Narrator talks over the book icon.

storyboard.claim: The show will dissect the mechanics of the cast system, not the weapons.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Narrator on a plain set.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sets the topic.
storyboard.addedInformation: Says the focus is the cast system, not weaponry.
storyboard.staging: Narrator only: show commentary.

storyboard.claim: Science fiction usually marvels at the weapons of the ruling class.
storyboard.concreteVisual: War icon for the weapons and bombardments.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Contrasts the usual focus with this one.
storyboard.addedInformation: Lists the weapons the genre celebrates.
storyboard.staging: Narrator over the war icon.

storyboard.claim: The hierarchy does not survive on force; the society rests on the lowest cast, the Reds.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow slumped, bearing the weight of the society on his back.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the weapons to the base.
storyboard.addedInformation: Puts the Reds underneath the whole society.
storyboard.staging: Slump with worry: the weight is his.

storyboard.claim: The rulers keep the Reds down with a story about the future, a very specific lie.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Titus smirking as he talks, a Gold telling a story.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the base to the method of control.
storyboard.addedInformation: Says the control is a story, not a gun.
storyboard.staging: Smirk shows the charm-with-an-edge that sells the lie.

storyboard.claim: The lie is that immense suffering is a noble sacrifice.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow slumped with a sad face under a plain background.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: States the lie plainly.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the lie in the narrator's own words.
storyboard.staging: Sad slump: the suffering the lie covers.

storyboard.claim: The psychological cage is more effective than any physical weapon.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Chains icon with Darrow worried inside it.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why the lie works.
storyboard.addedInformation: Compares the cage to the weapons named earlier.
storyboard.staging: Chains read as bound; the callout says cage.

storyboard.claim: The macro structure of Brown's society is next.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Narrator on a plain set.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the cage to the structure.
storyboard.addedInformation: Says the next part is the structure.
storyboard.staging: Narrator only.

storyboard.claim: The whole solar system is stratified by colour-coded casts.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Narrator pointing out across a horizon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Scales up to the solar system.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the colour coding.
storyboard.staging: Point across the horizon: the scale.

storyboard.claim: Castes are engineered over centuries to serve specific functions, from bottom to top.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sorter diagram with three buckets: Reds, Grays, Golds.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The structure now becomes a diagram.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the three castes as sorted buckets.
storyboard.staging: Structural beat: diagram only.

storyboard.claim: The Reds live at the bottom, and Darrow is the hell diver from the shaft.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow, the hell diver, in the underground dark.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Links the diagram to the protagonist.
storyboard.addedInformation: Gives his age and job as the callout.
storyboard.staging: Worried face; the callout names him.

storyboard.claim: The Reds exist only to mine helium 3, a volatile element.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow in the mine with the helium 3 deposits around him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: States their sole purpose.
storyboard.addedInformation: Says the element is volatile, which is why the work is dangerous.
storyboard.staging: Idle worried figure in the mine.

storyboard.claim: The grays are the police force and military garrison above the Reds.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Law icon for the police force.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves up to the second caste.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the grays' job.
storyboard.staging: Narrator over the law icon.

storyboard.claim: The grays are the immediate boot on the neck, the middle management of oppression.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dan, the Gray guard, angry, pointing down.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the grays a face.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the boot as their role.
storyboard.staging: Angry pointing guard: threat, not friendliness.

storyboard.claim: The Golds at the apex genetically perfected, the ruling class that orchestrates everything.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Puppeteer icon with Titus smirking above it.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves to the top caste.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows one class controlling the rest.
storyboard.staging: Smirk with the puppeteer icon: control with an edge.

storyboard.claim: Millions of slaves firmly believe they are honoured pioneers building humanity's survival.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Eo and Darrow with proud, hopeful faces, celebrating.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The scope of the belief.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the belief as pioneering.
storyboard.staging: Happy here is the belief itself, not a fake smile.

storyboard.claim: The Golds meticulously construct the illusion.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Mask icon with Titus smirking beside it.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the belief to its maker.
storyboard.addedInformation: The mask says the illusion is worn.
storyboard.staging: Smirk plus mask: a false public face.

callout.text: Woven into the fabric of survival

storyboard.claim: The lie is woven into daily survival, starting with the drive for achievement.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Narrator on a plain set.
storyboard.onScreenText: Woven into the fabric of survival
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains how the illusion works.
storyboard.addedInformation: Describes the weaving as the mechanism.
storyboard.staging: Narrator only.

storyboard.claim: The laurel is a gamified form of oppression.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Game icon for the competition.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Introduces the laurel.
storyboard.addedInformation: Labels the laurel as a game.
storyboard.staging: Narrator over the game icon.

storyboard.claim: Darrow takes a reckless maneuver, risking his team to hit a massive helium 3 vein.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow thinking hard over the vein at the drill.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Back to the shaft event.
storyboard.addedInformation: Adds the cost to the team.
storyboard.staging: Think pose: the calculation of the risk.

storyboard.claim: After the shift, the flush is a masterpiece of sensory degradation.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Narrator pointing into a dark room.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves to the place.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the flush as the place.
storyboard.staging: Point into the room.

storyboard.claim: The flush is cramped, pitch black, and packed with thousands after shifts.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow in a dark crowded chamber, one figure, the dark around him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes the flush.
storyboard.addedInformation: Gives the crowd size in words, not repeated figures.
storyboard.staging: Single figure: the crowd is named, not drawn.

storyboard.claim: Air blasts from tubes at high velocity, stripping skin and dirt; it is deafening.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow with a fearful face under the blasting tubes.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Adds the sensory assault.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes the noise visible as the callout.
storyboard.staging: Afraid face under the tubes.

storyboard.claim: The flush strips each man of individual identity, but Darrow's tribe is still elated.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow with a sad face in the flush.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Ends the flush and sets up the euphoria.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the loss of identity as the flush's purpose.
storyboard.staging: Sad face, idle body.

storyboard.claim: The Lambda clan is euphoric after the win.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Trophy icon with Darrow and Eo celebrating.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the flush to the win.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the win as a prize.
storyboard.staging: Celebrate: genuine euphoria after the win.

storyboard.claim: Darrow pulled 9,000 kilos of helium 3 and they think they won the laurel.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Darrow celebrating beside the helium 3 haul.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Names the haul behind the win.
storyboard.addedInformation: Gives the quantity as a number.
storyboard.staging: Celebrate with the haul named.

callout.text: Twenty-four clans compete for the prize

storyboard.claim: Twenty-four clans compete every quarter for the laurel, and the rewards are not metals or titles.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Narrator on a plain set.
storyboard.onScreenText: Twenty-four clans compete for the prize
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the laurel contest.
storyboard.addedInformation: Says there are twenty-four clans and a quarterly contest.
storyboard.staging: Narrator only.
